spans.s:
रङ्क रङ्क, अस्, आ, अम्, niggardly, mean,
indigent, poor, miserable, hungry, (कङ्क-रङ्क,
a hungry or half-starved crane; cf. जल-र्˚, मत्स्य-
र्˚); slow; (अस्), m. a beggar.

रङ्कु रङ्कु, उस्, m. a species of deer or
antelope; N. of a place.
—रङ्कु-मालिन्, ई, m.,
N. of a Vidyā-dhara.
रङ्क्तृ रङ्क्तृ. See रक्तृ, p. 828, col. 1.
रङ्क्षु रङ्क्षु, N. of a river.
रङ्ख् रङ्ख् = rt. रख्, q. v.

रङ्ग् रङ्ग् (= rt. रिङ्ग्), cl. 1. P. रङ्गति,
&c., to go, move.
रङ्ग रङ्ग, रङ्गिन्, &c. See p. 828.

रङ्ग, अस्, m. colour, paint, pigment, dye, hue;
the nasal modification or nasalizing of a vowel; a
place of public amusement or for dramatic exhibi-
tions, theatre, play-house, amphitheatre, stage, arena,
place of public contest, place for athletic exercises or
feats, sports, &c.; a place of assembly; an assembly or
assemblage of spectators; a field of battle; dancing,
singing, acting, diversion, mirth; borax; an extract
obtained from Acacia Catechu; a proper N.; (अम्),
n. tin (= वङ्ग; in this sense also अस्, m.).
—रङ्ग-
कार or रङ्ग-कारक, अस्, m. ‘a colour-maker,’
painter, colourist.
—रङ्ग-काष्ठ, अम्, n. Cæsal-
pina Sappan.
—रङ्ग-क्षेत्र, अम्, n., N. of a
place.
—रङ्ग-चर, अस्, m. ‘a stage-goer,’ stage-
player, actor, player, performer, &c.; a gladiator.
—रङ्ग-ज, अम्, n. red lead, vermilion.
—रङ्ग-
जीवक, अस्, m. ‘living by colours,’ a painter, an
actor, performer.
—रङ्ग-द, अस्, m. borax; an
extract from Acacia Catechu; a particular white
paint (= स्फटी, दृढ-रङ्गा).
—रङ्ग-दत्त,
(probably) अम्, n., N. of a drama.
—रङ्ग-दायक,
अम्, n. a particular kind of earth (= कङ्कुष्ठ).
—रङ्ग-दृढा, f. a sort of white paint (=
दृढ-रङ्गा).
—रङ्ग-देवता, f. a goddess sup-
[]
posed to preside over sports and diversions, the god-
dess or genius of pleasure.
—रङ्ग-द्वार्, र्, f. a stage-
door, the door or entrance of a theatre.
—रङ्ग-द्वार,
अम्, n. a stage-entrance, stage-door; the prologue of
a play.
—रङ्ग-नाथ, अस्, m., N. of various men;
of the author of a commentary on the Vikramorvaśī-
(A.

); of a commentator on the Sūrya-
siddhānta.
—रङ्ग-पताका, f., N. of a woman.
—रङ्ग-पत्त्री or रङ्ग-पुष्पी, f. the indigo
plant.
—रङ्ग-पीठ, अम्, n. a place for dancing.
—रङ्ग-प्रवेश, अस्, m. entering on the stage,
engaging in theatrical performances.
—रङ्ग-भूति,
इस्, f. the night of full moon in the month Āśvina.
—रङ्ग-भूमि, इस्, f. a place for acting, stage,
theatre, arena; a battle-field,
—रङ्ग-मङ्गल,
अम्, n. a stage-festival, rejoicing or festive ceremony
on the stage.
—रङ्ग-मण्डप, अस्, अम्, m. n. a
play-house, theatre.
—रङ्ग-मण्डल, अम्, n. the
circuit of an arena or assembly.
—रङ्ग-मध्य,
अम्, n. the middle of an arena.
—रङ्ग-मल्ल,
अस्, m. a proper N.; (ई), f. the Indian lute.
—रङ्ग-
माणिक्य, अम्, n. a ruby (= माणिक्य).
—रङ्ग-
मातृ, ता, f. lac or the insect which forms the red
dye; a bawd; = त्रुटि.
—रङ्ग-मातृका, f. lac.
—रङ्ग-राज, अस्, m., N. of a king; of a learned
man, (also called Raṅgarāja-dīkṣita, &c.)
—रङ्ग-
लासिनी, f. Nyctanthes Arbor Tristis.
—रङ्ग-वती,
f., N. of a woman (who killed her husband Ranti-
deva).
—रङ्ग-वल्लिका or रङ्ग-वल्ली, f., N. of
a kind of plant used at sacrifices.
—रङ्ग-वस्तु, उ,
n. any colouring substance, paint.
—रङ्ग-वाट,
a place or arena enclosed for contests, plays, dancing,
&c.
—रङ्ग-वाराङ्गना (˚र-अङ्˚), f. a kind of
dancing girl.
—रङ्ग-विद्या-धर, अस्, m. a pro-
ficient in or teacher of the art of acting.
—रङ्ग-
वीज, अम्, n. silver.
—रङ्ग-शाला, f. a play-house,
theatre, dancing-hall, dancing-room.
—रङ्ग-स्थ,
अस्, आ, अम्, standing in an arena.
—रङ्गाङ्गण
(˚ग-अङ्˚), अम्, n. the area of an amphitheatre or
arena, an arena or place of public contest.
—रङ्-
गाङ्गा (˚ग-अङ्˚), f. a particular white substance
(= स्फटी).
—रङ्गाजीव (˚ग-आज्˚), अस्, m. ‘living
by colours,’ a painter; one who lives by the stage,
an actor, performer.
—रङ्गारि (˚ग-अरि), इस्, m. a
fragrant Oleander.
—रङ्गावतरण (˚ग-अव्˚),
अम्, n. entering on the stage, engaging in theatrical
performances; the profession of an actor.
—रङ्गा-
वतारक (˚ग-अव्˚), अस्, or रङ्गावतारिन्, ई, m.
one who enters the stage or engages in theatrical
performances, a stage-player, actor.
—रङ्गेश (˚ग-
ईश), अस्, m., N. of a king.
—रङ्गेश्वरी (˚ग-ईश्˚),
f. (probably) N. of the wife of Raṅgeśa.
—रङ्-
गेष्ठालुक (˚ठ-आल्˚), अम्, n. a kind of bulbous
root or onion, (also रङ्गेष्ठालु.)
—रङ्गोप-
जीविन् (˚ग-उप्˚), ई, or रङ्गोपजीव्य, अस्, m. one
who lives by the stage, a stage-player, actor.
राङ्ग राङ्ग, अस्, m. a proper N.

रङ्गोजि रङ्गोजि, इस्, or रङ्गोजि-भट्ट, अस्,
m., N. of the father of Koṇḍabhaṭṭa and brother of
Bhaṭṭoji.

रङ्घ् रङ्घ् [cf. rt. रंह्], cl. 1. A. रङ्-
घते, ररङ्घे, रङ्घितुम्, to go, hasten,
run; cl. 10. P. or Caus. रङ्घयति, -यितुम्, to
speak; to shine.
रङ्घस्, अस्, n. = रंहस्, haste, speed, velocity.

रङ्गण, अम्, n. (probably) dancing, merry-
making, &c.

राङ्गण राङ्गण, अम्, n. a kind of flower
(commonly called Raṅgan).

रङ्गिन्, ई, इणी, इ, colouring, dyeing, painting;
passionate, impassioned; attached to, devoted to,
finding enjoyment in; acting or exhibiting on a
stage, being an actor; (इणी), f. Asparagus Race-
mosus.
राङ्कल राङ्कल, अस्, m. a thorn.

राङ्कव राङ्कव, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging to the
Raṅku species of deer; made from the hair of the
Raṅku deer, woollen; coming from Raṅku (said of
animals, see Pāṇ.

); (अम्), n. woollen
cloth made of deer's hair, a woollen cover or gar-
ment; a rug, blanket.
—राङ्कवाजिन (˚व-अज्˚),
अम्, n. a woollen skin.
—राङ्कवास्तरण (˚व-
आस्˚), अम्, n. a woollen coverlet.
—राङ्कवास्तृत
(˚व-आस्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, covered with a woollen rug.

राङ्कवक, अस्, ई, अम्, coming from Raṅku
(said of men, see Pāṇ.

राङ्कवायण, अस्, ई, अम्, coming from Raṅku
(said of animals).
रङ्ग-द; for ‘paint’ read substance.
